in_sanskrit.name: Rakib
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Holder of power
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rakib एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Rakib is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rakta' which means 'blood'. This name is believed to be a symbol of power, strength and courage. It is a name given to a ruler or a warrior, who holds the power to protect and rule.
